take_homes: Access and absorption are different numbers. Licences activated says nothing about whether people use the tool, and I should ask for the second one.
A new tool competes with the spreadsheet or colleague the person already trusts. Ask what would have to be true for them to switch.
A plan with unnamed owners is not a plan. Start with one person and one conversation before building anything more.

misconception.why: I walked in thinking AI is a licence you buy. The 'access is not absorption' line made me see that the licence is the cheap part. I still can't put a number on the capability part, so it is shaken, not changed.

one_line: Good thinking about why rollouts stall, but nothing on cost or payback, and that same filler paragraph appears four times.
